access_time_basis: UTC; page retrieval timestamps were recorded during this stage. Product documentation was retrieved around 2026-10-10T04:33:37Z unless an entry states otherwise.

sources.title: Zotero: Adding items to Zotero
sources.locator: Add Item by Identifier; metadata verification notes
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no Zotero client or API was operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Identifier entry accepts ISBN, DOI, PubMed ID, arXiv ID, and ADS Bibcode; results may be incomplete or wrong and should be checked. Connector workflows may download PDFs and are excluded from this proposal.
sources.applicability: Supports optional identifier-based intake and explicit human verification; does not establish current build behavior or group-level provenance.

sources.title: Zotero: Duplicate detection
sources.version_or_commit: Help page last updated 2017-11-25; age is a material currency limitation
sources.locator: Duplicate detection and merge behavior
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no library was operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Documented duplicate comparison uses title/DOI/ISBN and can also use nearby years and partial creator match; scope is one library. Merge allows manual selection for field conflicts. The page says false positives cannot be marked nonduplicate.
sources.applicability: Comparator only; exact rules must be verified against chosen current release before use. Heuristic matches must not authorize silent merges.

sources.title: Zotero: Item types and fields
sources.locator: Preprint and Journal Article item type definitions; DOI field availability
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only.
sources.condition_default_exception: Preprint represents a version before formal peer review, potentially available before or after journal publication; Journal Article represents a journal-published item. DOI is not a required field and may be stored in Extra for some types.
sources.applicability: Supports distinct version records and DOI-optional records; not a universal version identity rule.

sources.title: Zotero: Importing standardized formats
sources.locator: Supported standardized input formats
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; import not run.
sources.condition_default_exception: Lists BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, CSL JSON, and additional formats; implementation details may vary by release.
sources.applicability: Evidence that RIS and BibTeX are plausible interoperability targets; verify with selected release and fixtures.

sources.title: Zotero: Exporting
sources.locator: Export library, collection, or items; export limitations
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; export not run.
sources.condition_default_exception: Export is not a backup; exported files can omit app-specific links/timestamps and format-dependent fields.
sources.applicability: Supports a conditional export feature and field-by-field round-trip validation; not proof of exact selected format fidelity.

sources.title: Zotero: Creating bibliographies
sources.version_or_commit: Official help page; version date not exposed in retrieved result
sources.locator: Quick Copy and bibliography output formats
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation/search result only; no bibliography generated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Quick Copy can produce BibTeX/RIS or formatted bibliography outputs such as RTF/HTML; output depends on user-selected style and settings.
sources.applicability: Supports style/export alternatives; group lead still chooses style and default format.

sources.title: Zotero: Translators
sources.version_or_commit: Official developer documentation; version date not exposed in retrieved result
sources.locator: Exporter output and Export Files/Notes/Tags options
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation/search result only; no translator or export operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Exporter preferences expose separate file, note, and tag toggles; proposal explicitly disables files/notes and reviews tag scope rather than assuming defaults.
sources.applicability: Supports preventing attachment/full-text leakage in an optional metadata export; confirm exact UI and setting persistence in chosen release.

sources.title: Paperpile: Import RIS/BibTeX
sources.locator: Import steps; Skip duplicates; duplicate rows within one input file
sources.observed_operation: Read public official help only; no account/import was used.
sources.condition_default_exception: Skip duplicates is on by default; when on, already-present references and later duplicates in the same input file are skipped, with only the first in-file occurrence imported.
sources.applicability: Shows convenience and provenance risk; keep submitted rows independently even if destination manager skips a record.

sources.title: Paperpile: Duplicates explained
sources.locator: Candidate identity rules, dismissing false match, merge behavior
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no library was operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Candidates may match on common identifiers or exact metadata when no shared ID exists; records with no shared ID and differing metadata may be missed. False matches can be dismissed. Merge consolidates metadata and related fields, moving originals to Trash.
sources.applicability: Useful alternative comparator; do not equate its product-specific identity rules with canonical scholarly identity.

sources.title: Paperpile: Export library data
sources.version_or_commit: Official help page; version date not exposed in retrieved result
sources.locator: Supported BibTeX, RIS, CSV, JSON; limitations
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; export not run.
sources.condition_default_exception: Lists BibTeX, RIS, CSV, JSON; calls RIS an industry standard and BibTeX widely supported; Paperpile JSON is internal/non-reimportable. Library-data export excludes PDFs.
sources.applicability: Supports RIS/BibTeX as candidate formats; actual metadata fidelity and selected-reader compatibility remain untested.

sources.title: Paperpile: Search online
sources.locator: Online search fields and add/result actions
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; search was not operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Search can use title, authors, URL, ISBN, DOI, PMID, PMC ID, arXiv ID, and PII; result is presented for user addition.
sources.applicability: Workflow comparator for candidate discovery, not evidence that every result is correct or current.

sources.title: Paperpile: Update metadata automatically
sources.version_or_commit: Official help article updated 2026-08-31, based on official indexed result
sources.locator: Manual and bulk update outcomes; candidate and field-difference workflow
sources.observed_operation: Official search index result read; direct page open returned timeout/502 twice. No interface was exercised.
sources.condition_default_exception: Indexed result describes matching candidates, visible field changes, Apply versus close/discard, and no-match/up-to-date outcomes; exact current interface behavior is not independently confirmed here.
sources.applicability: Supports a review-before-apply design pattern only; validate in selected product/version or use our own explicit proposal/approval contract.

sources.title: OpenRefine: Reconciling
sources.locator: Candidate lists, scores, user choice, original cell value and matched link
sources.observed_operation: Read public official manual only; no OpenRefine service or project operated.
sources.condition_default_exception: Candidates and scores depend on provider; user can inspect/select. Documentation also describes confident auto-match behavior for sufficiently strong matches.
sources.applicability: Analogy for retaining submitted raw value beside reconciliation link; proposal disables automatic merge/correction pending editor approval.

sources.title: OpenRefine: Reconciliation service API
sources.version_or_commit: API v0.2; supported since OpenRefine 3.3; manual last updated 2026-06-06
sources.locator: Candidate ranking, query, type/property constraints, previews
sources.observed_operation: Read public official technical documentation only; API not called.
sources.condition_default_exception: Service proposes ranked candidates and may provide previews; response is provider data, not accepted catalog truth.
sources.applicability: Supports storing provider response separately from editor-approved correction; not a product recommendation.

sources.title: OpenRefine: Clustering
sources.locator: Text clustering methods and fingerprint caveats
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; clustering not run.
sources.condition_default_exception: Clustering is syntactic; fingerprint method is described as less likely to create false positives than alternatives, not semantically authoritative.
sources.applicability: Useful for surfacing spelling/format variants only; insufficient to establish that scholarly records or versions are identical.

sources.title: Crossref: Simple Text Query
sources.locator: Single/batch citation query and ambiguous/no-match outcomes
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no citation or API query issued.
sources.condition_default_exception: May return several possible DOIs or no single match when metadata is insufficient; user evaluation is required.
sources.applicability: Supports optional candidate lookup and explicit ambiguity handling, not automatic metadata replacement.

sources.title: Crossref: Retrieve metadata
sources.locator: Public metadata model; deposited metadata and relations
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no endpoint queried.
sources.condition_default_exception: Metadata is primarily deposited by members and may be incomplete; Crossref also includes inferred relationship metadata and may match references without DOI.
sources.applicability: Supports public lookup with provenance and uncertainty; deposited/inferred data is not an automatic authority to overwrite volunteer input.

sources.title: Crossref REST API access and authentication
sources.locator: Public and polite pool access, limits, backoff
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no endpoint queried.
sources.condition_default_exception: Public API needs no sign-up; documented public limits are lower than polite-pool limits; polite pool uses mailto identification; clients should back off and respect service policy.
sources.applicability: A lead-approved optional provider can be publicly queried without contributor accounts, subject to limits and operational review.

sources.title: Crossref: Relationship metadata
sources.version_or_commit: Official schema guide; version date not exposed in retrieved result
sources.locator: Typed `isPreprintOf` / `hasPreprint` relationships and related identifiers
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only.
sources.condition_default_exception: Relations can point to Crossref DOI, another agency DOI, or non-DOI identifier; non-DOI target identity is not DOI-validated.
sources.applicability: Supports separate version records plus typed relation; relationship itself does not authorize merging records.

sources.title: DataCite: Versioning
sources.version_or_commit: Official support page retrieved 2026-10-10; page described same DOI for minor update/new DOI for major version
sources.locator: Major/minor version DOI and relation behavior
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only; no DOI record edited or queried.
sources.condition_default_exception: Stewardship decides major/minor; same DOI may be reused for minor changes, new DOI and typed relation may be used for major change.
sources.applicability: Evidence against treating DOI as a universally unique scholarly version identifier.

sources.title: DataCite: Preprints, post-prints, and author manuscripts
sources.locator: Different manuscript versions may have distinct DOIs; IsVersionOf relation guidance
sources.observed_operation: Read public official documentation only.
sources.condition_default_exception: Different versions can have different DOIs; guidance recommends searching Crossref and DataCite and using IsVersionOf where appropriate.
sources.applicability: Supports retaining separate preprint and published-version records with explicit links.

sources.title: JabRef issue #15106
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2026-02-13; reporter states JabRef 5.15 on Ubuntu 24.04.4; closed 2026-03-13 via PR #15315
sources.locator: Reproduction and affected BibTeX page range/RIS fields
sources.observed_operation: Read public GitHub issue only; issue reproduction was not run.
sources.condition_default_exception: For a BibTeX pages value such as 13905--13911, reported RIS output placed the whole range in SP and EP; a single dash worked.
sources.applicability: Narrow reported defect on specific exporter path and input; does not establish generic RIS or all-release behavior.

sources.title: JabRef pull request #15315
sources.version_or_commit: Merged 2026-03-13; merge commit shown as d687c08
sources.locator: Fix description and tests for ASCII/en/em dash page-range splitting
sources.observed_operation: Read public GitHub pull request only; code/tests were not executed in this stage.
sources.condition_default_exception: Change accepts en/em dash as delimiters when splitting first and last page values; applicability is page-range parsing in this exporter path.
sources.applicability: Documents a fix linked from issue #15106; a contributor's code test is not this stage's validation.
